fields.Name: T207 - Edit Dropdown Field and Save
fields.Description: Changes a dropdown/picklist field value on an Event record and saves, verifying dropdown field editing.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Events' entity grid — type 'Events' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click the exact 'Events' node (or, if the search is giving you trouble, navigate directly to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Events). Click a row, then click 'Open Full Record'. Find a dropdown/picklist field on the form (for example 'Event Type', or any field that opens a list of options when clicked — it shows a chevron/caret). Open it and select a DIFFERENT option than the current one. An unsaved-changes 'Save Changes' banner appears at the TOP — click 'Save Changes'. Verify the save succeeds with no error and the field shows the newly selected option. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A dropdown/picklist field's value was changed to a different option on an Event record
Save Changes was clicked and the save succeeded; the field shows the new option
No error messages or crash pages
